tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (287)༄༅/ /dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi mnan pa'i yig chung gcig shes kun grol bzhugs/(288)khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs dang lhag pa'i lha/ /'chol ba'i
(287)༄༅/ /dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi mnan pa'i yig chung gcig shes kun grol bzhugs/(288)khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs dang lhag pa'i lha/ /'chol ba'i

tei:div.tei:p: (287)༄༅// dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi mnan pa'i yig chung gcig shes kun grol bzhugs/ (288)khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs dang lhag pa'i lha// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen por gus btud nas// mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po yi// bcas gshom lag len 'chad 'dod gnang ba stsol// de yang man ngag snying gzer nag po las/ dmigs rten 'bem du bca' ba ni: dgra bgegs liṅga 'bri ba yin: snying gar rnam shes yig 'bru re: dpral bar ming bri kha la rus: steng 'og gnyis la gcod gzir gnyis: mtha' la 'phrog byed yi ge bzhi: yan lag bzhi la gcod byed bzhi: dpung pa gnyis la myos byed bris: 'di la gzugs can zugs med do: zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don gyi zab gnad rnams gtso bor byas te man ngag gis (289)brgyan pa'i dgra 'dre'i liṅga so sor bri ba yin te/ de yang dus tshod ni/ gyim shang zhags pa nag po las/ shog gu gro ga ro ras la/ khrag chen btsan dug sbyar nas ni// phung gsum bra nyi'i nyin zhag la// gtum pa stag gi dus tshod dus/

nyi ma rtse shar nas drod tshun chod/ khams dang sbyar ba'i phung dus der/ rus chen gang yin/ las byed 'brug gi nyi ma la// dgra bdud dur zhugs kun la bgre/ zhes dang*/ drang srong na lde du rtse ba'i man ngag las/ nam langs yos la nyi shar 'brug /dus tshod bcu gnyis des 'gre'o// snga dro me la nyin gung sa// phyi dro lcags la dgongs ka chu// nyi shar shing la sa sros shing*// srod 'khor (290)me la nam gung sa// tho rang lcags la skya rengs chu// 'di rnams zhib tu brtsi ba gnad// ces dang*/ stag lo'i bdud skar mchu me gnyis// yos su'i sbo la 'brug pa re// sbrul gyi dbyug gu lag sor re// rta snubs lha mtshams gnyis po ste/ lug gi cu smad gro bzhin dang*// sprel gyi mon gre mon gru gnyis// bya yi khrums stod khrums smad dang*// khyi yi nam gru dbyu gu ste// phag gi smin drug snra ma dang*// byi ba'i mgo lag glang nabs rgyal// de ni skar ma'i gyim shang ngo*/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang lo zla zhag dus za bdun mthun bdud sogs zhib tu brtsi dgos kyang de tsam gyis mtha' bsdus nas/ mi 'dus rkyen bzhi shor rkyen bzhi// rten la mi khug gnad bzhi po// spangs nas tshad ldan bri bar bya// zhes pa'i skyon bral zhig nges par gtsor che/ thog mar rang gi kha lag gdong gsum dag par bkrus na/ (291)sgo gsum gyi nus pa rgya/ de rjes lag par bsad khrag dang bsad thal byugs/ sha chen nam tsha ba gsum mur bzhin par (sang )kheb kha ras dang bcas lha'i rgyal la gnas pas/ kha blta phyogs/ dmigs bya'i bdud gcod dam lho nub/ lho/ sgra gcan sde brgyad sogs kyi thebs phyogs dang*/ nyi ma'i 'char bzhud sogs/ rang grib mi 'go ba'i thabs sogs phyogs mthun rigs pa'i mda' mo yang 'phen/ snag tsha'i rgyu yugs sa'i khog dreg gam/ rgya snag gtsang ma ro sel sogs la mchod rten rnying pa'i rmang zhabs/

phung shul/ ri mtho nyi 'char snga ba'i rmangs sogs dang*/ phag nag gri mdze/ ra khrag bya sha zan/ gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi khrag btsan dug tel nag ldong ros/ lan tshwa/ skye tshe/ zar khu/ mi rus sogs ci (292)'dzom bsres nas thod ngan nam/ gri lcags kyi kong bur sbyangs pas las rang bzhin gyis 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod/ spro na bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod kyi ting 'dzin sngags rgyas gzas po dngos su bkug la snag tsha dang dbyer med ro gcig tu bstim la rus pa'am lcags kyi lde mig gis snag tsha mnye ba dang phye mar 'thag pa'i dmigs pa byed/ bris smyug ni mi bsad mda' smyug gam/ bya sha zan gyi sgro rtsa srid gter las/ khyad par pho rog shis pa yin: zhes gsungs/ che chung tshad ni rab la mda' gang ngam// 'bring thar gzas po'i khru gang mtho gang bya// mi 'byams gnad la grong yul pha ma dang*// bu tsha'i ming sogs shar yig dri mar gsungs// ma bub ma zha ma long ma 'gyed gnad/ sri can la liṅga spyi khog 'dra ba la/ khyad par dgra mig rnams su sri ming dang snying gar tri/ mgo bo bsgyur (293)dgos pas pho sri la g.yag dkar/ spyang ki 'ang gsungs/ mo sri la khyi/ rgan sri wa/ dur sri bre mong*/ dar sri spyang ki dur sri wa/ dam sri phag spyi'i phung sri rnga mong*/ rgyal sri seṅge/ blon sri ri bong*/ dmangs sri dre'u/ dgra sri spyang ki mtshon sri shab gzhan yang mtshon khral bsdus nas de tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du bcings mnan dus su rtse mo thur la bstan nas mnan chas steng du bcug de'i steng du mchod rten bzhengs pa la sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa byin rlabs dang ldan pas rab gnas byas na/ mtshon dang 'khrug pa mtha' dmag sogs zhi bar gsungs pas/ mchod rten ma grub kyangamatshon sri'i rigs la de bzhin bstan 'gror dmigs nas bya thub na legs/ god sri ra g.ya' sri 'phar ba/ nye sri sdig pa/ byis sri rta'am rkyen gang yin/

gdon sri'i rigs la/ btsan sri dmar po 'ug mgo rgyal sri (294)dkar po bya pho/ klu sri sngon po sbrul/ bdud sri nag po khyu+ung*/ lo sri lo bdud/ zla sri zla bdud kyi mgo can/ dus sri dus der dmod pa sogs so/ dpral bar e trig nan/ mig gnyis la longs/ rna ba gnyis la 'on/ sna la thibs/ kha nang du bdud phong long*/ mgrin par brjod/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon la dza hūm̐/ pus mo g.yas g.yon la baṃ ho/ nyā ldir bzir mā ra ya rbad ces 'bru bzhi'i 'og tu zha re re/ gsang bar phaṭa/ rka mthil gnyis su yaṃ re re/ snying ga'i sa bon la dzaḥkha sprod/ steng du e/ g.yon du hur/ 'og tu thuṃ/ g.yas su dzaḥ de rgyab ling ga'i mgrin pa'i phyogs nas yig mgo phyi la bstan te/ bla 'gugs sngags bris/ brla g.yas g.yon du/ dar sri gdug pa can gyi bla srog shakati thun dzaḥ zhes pa'i yig mgo pus mo nas brtsams te bris/ liṅga'-i phyi rol du mgo bo nas bzung sngags mgo phyi (295)bstan du/ gzhung gi mnan sngags dang dmod byang bris/ de rgyab dzaḥgram nyer gcig gis bskor ro// dgra bo'i snying ga'i sa bon la yig rigs mi 'dra mang du byung*/ lnga pa chen po'i phyag bzhes la nri 'di bzhin dang*/ dbur smyon chos kyi grags pas gshin rje lcags sdig gi lu+ung khungs su nṛ 'di bzhin 'dren/ gzhan dag ni nṛ 'di bzhin bzhed cing*/ don du 'gro ba mi'i sa bon nyon mongs dug gsum gyi ngo bo/ snying dbus khrag sbal gyi nang du yi ge'i rnam par gnas pa/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung du dug gsum rang rgyud la shar ba'i/ 'dod chags bya/ zhe sdang sbrul/ gti mug phag ste gsum po'i gzugs kyis mtshon byed dpe'i dbyibs su grub/ spro na dgra ling gi brla g.yas par sha ba'i gzugs brnyan nam/ sha ba zhes ming bris pa'i mthar// dgra bo'i bla 'khyams sha bar brdzu bar dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bskor te 'bri/ de bzhin du rkyang la k+ṣa/

rta la rta/(296)g.yag la nu/ bong bu la tri/ glang la mu ste bla rtags che ba drug gi srog dang*/ byi ba la hu/ phag pa la sa/ gna' bar la/ lug la se/ ra la dza/ gla ba la bha te chung ba drug gi srog mthar dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'di dang 'di ru brdzu ba dzaḥdzaḥ zhes snga ma ji bzhin du bris/ brla g.yon par bla len 'phar ba/ spyang ki dom/ dred/ khra/ glag sogs bla gshed drug gi khog par dgra bo glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi'i bla me yin pas/ sha ra bha te mā ra ya rbad/ ces rta'i gshed sngags dang sa la pra bhe ma ti rbad/ ces sbrul gyi gshed sngags dang*/ des 'gre bar stag yos long pa'i bla de'i mi ma yin pa'i byi phag gnyis kyi gshed sngags/ sa dhi tsā ya du bhi tri rbad/ ces byi ba dang*/ bo po lu sha su ta rbad/ ces phag rta sbul lo sar/ a bhi ta ra me bhi rbad/ ces stag dang*/ sha sa ka ra ha ra rbad/ ces yos/ bya sprel lo par/ ya nan+ta gh+ri ta (297)rbad/ ces glang dang*/ par sha bh+yu ti sa phag rbad/ ces lug shu na pa su ra tra rbad/ ces khyi/ sa ta ga te li du rbad/ ces 'brug de yang dper na glang lo pa yin na sgrub gang rung res chog ste/ gnyis ka 'bri mi dgos sogs gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o// bla bdud gzugs la dbab pa ni/ phyad ma'i bla dwags bri ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa yin/ yang na yi ge tsha la/ troṃ/ tri/ shaṃ tri/ dzaḥ khaṃ/ sha/ gha/ dzaḥ traṃ/ thuṃ dzaḥ sogs yig mgo lta phyogs phor phyi/ mor ldog nas 'khor mar bris/ yang na/ tri troṃ sham gha sha dzaḥthuṃ/ yang na bla chen drug gi ming mthar bla khug dzaḥ yang na gnod byed dgra bo'i bla gang du brdzus kyang khug dzaḥ shes bla rtsa ba nas phred la bris/ dpral bar rus shes na de ka'i mthar khug dzaḥ ma shes na thams cad rus chen sder lngar 'du bas/ ji'u kung keg shang khug dzaḥ(298)mgo bor dgra mgo thog tu babs pa thams cad s+t+wam bha ya nan/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/

de liṅga mi gzugs pho mo gang 'os kyi rtags can rid cing mya ngan gyi gdung ba'i tshul/ mig shi mig kha gdangs zhing yan lag bzhi lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i liṅga de nyid lhag chad bri bsub spang (ri ) te dag par bri/ gal te bri bsubs byed dgos na stag gi sder mos brad/ dmigs bya legs par 'char ba dang phyi nang bye ma gsher ldan gyis phur zan gtsang ma'i dri la phyis bya/ tshon gtong ba/ kha dog 'byung ba gshed du bsdeb/ ces pas dmigs bya'i srog khams dang bstun/ thun 'khor lo'i gshed du bsdeb dgos pa sogs phra zhib kyi lag len mthong rgyun bzhin bya'o// skabs 'dir ling khrus bya ba ni/ rang gi mdun du yo byad rnams 'du byas la/ dang po rang grib sbyong ba ni/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar sad zla'i steng : (299) rdor sems dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od du 'bar: rdo rje dril 'dzin rin chen rus pas brgyan: dar zab longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs 'dzin: thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor: de las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: sgo gsum nyes tshogs thams cad sangs kyis dag: slar yang 'od 'phros 'phags pa thams cad mchod: tshur 'dus bdag gi dam tshig nyams chag dang : byad phur ngag mnan gtad khram phra (mden )men gyi: nus mthu nyes tshogs ma lus rab byang nas: rang lus dwangs shel dri med lta bur gyur: yi ge brgya pa bzlas rjes/ mgon po bdag gi sdig sgrib ma lus pa: dag par thugs rje bskul ba'igadung shugs kyis: gnas gsum lha rnams 'od du zhu ba yis: dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu sa ma dhi: zhes brjod/ ling ga la (300)srid pa'i bye ma'am zhing sa gtsang ma 'thor zhing*/ laṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: zhes dang*/ chu mig lkugs pa'am phug rdugs kyi chu ro skra'i chun pos 'thor zhing*/ baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ de bzhin du lha dbye'i sgro gnyis kyis g.yab cing*/

yaṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ bra shing gi mes bskor zhing*/ raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ zhes pa la dri ma thim/ chus bkru/ rlung gis gtor/ mes bsregs pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing*/ bar snang la g.yab cing*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag yon mchod kyi lus kyi dri mas ma gos so/ ngag gi dri mas ma gos so/ yid kyi dri mas ma gos so/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri mas ma gos so// e horaṃ/ i na ri/ bi na raṃ/ shud+dhe shud+dhe a a/ zhes a rkyang nyer gcig dbugs thengs gcig la 'dren zhing gdod ma'i stong chen gyi ngang du kun rdzob kyi dri ma thams cad ye dag ye grol du sbyangs la dar gcig mnyam par bzhag zangs gzhong chu (301) gtsang gis bkang ba mdun du bzhag la/ bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod gsal ba yi// mdun du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyal 'gro'i dbus// paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng*// (saṃ)las chu yi lha mo sku mdog dkar// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas pad+ma dmar// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung rin chen brgyan// thugs las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes drangs// dzaḥham̐'u baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur// de yi phyag g.yas mchog sbyin baṃ ser las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs liṅga bshal ba yis// rnal 'byor bdag cag kha rlangs dri ma rdul// gzas po'i kha rje bsod nams tshe dpal 'byor// ma lus chu yi nang du sib kyis thim/ hūm̐ ma ma ka bya ye hūm̐/ 'chang ba po la hūm̐/ ma ma ka bya ye swā hā/ zhes liṅga bkrus/ slar yang chu yi lha mo 'od du zhu// chu dang dbyer (302)med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur// zhes brjod cing bsams la/ rang gis hub gcig 'thung bas tshe bsod bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam/ chu lhag gnas khang phyi nang khyab par gtor bas bkra shis byin chags/ 'bag btsog thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams/ byug rdzas ni/ khrag sna gang 'dzaum/

khyad par gri mdzo'i khrag dug sna ci tshogs/ thang khrom dkar nag btsan dug phung sa sogs gdug pa'i sa sna gang 'dzom/ lha khag rnying pa/ ṛ nyil/ mchod rten zhig ral sogs kyi sa dang*/ dmigs byar de'i dri ma drug sogs zag rdzas keg sri sogs bgegs rigs la 'dre tshugs kyi sa dang*/ gang gnod de'i sa rdo chu shing bsad khrag dug sna sogs/ byug rdzas rnams khu ba 'byin pa'i phyir mer bsros nas rlangs thon tsam byed nas byug ༈ bzlog bsad kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phung gsum sa la ba byung lnga'i: dkyil 'khor stegs bu mda' gang ba: (303)bdud rtsi khrag dang ldan pas byug: ces dang*/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i bar dag tu: ming rus ldan pa'i liṅga bcu: dpal gtor 'og tu cig kyang bkod: ces pa'i dkyil 'khor ma traṃ khog par 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud can/ lte ba chos 'byung rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su lcags snod sogs kyi brub khung mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du bcug rtsibs rtse rnams su ming rus ldan pa'i zan gyi nya bo bcu dang*/ mthar rtsang zor rdzas sogs 'god/ 'jug pa bde phyir phug pa sogs drag po'i sa sna dang bye ma la byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi ro sol dang thal chen gyis nag por byas pa'i dbus su brub khung phyed cha tsam nub par 'dug pa'am/ yang na lcags slang bug rdol med pa bye mas bkang ba'i dbus su brub khung ji ltar mtshon pa brus la/ gri khrag dug chu dur thal sogs kyis sbags pa'i mthar skyer tsang stod smad khrag dang dbus ro sol gyis nag pos (304)byug rtse mor sha yis brgyan pa nyer gcig srin mo 'gros sam 'tshub ma ris su btsugs la 'gugs byed kyi pho nyar mnga' gsol/ de nas liṅga rnams mang po yod na brtsegs/ 'khor ling yod tshad 'og tu bcug gzhug tshul ni/ ji skad du/ liṅga gshad bltab nṛ yig mthong*/ zhes pas mtha' nas rim par bsdus pa'i mchan ltes sam ro sgong dugrags pa'i snyig ga'i sa bon mthong ba'am/

yag na rke rgyab tu btsag pa'i g.yas g.yon gsham sogs zur lteb skur gsum bzos nas sa bon mthong ba shi skra dang byad thag gis cung zad dkris nas gzhug de'i steng du mañji'am srid pa lug 'byung drag po'i shing gi ye khrag steng mtho bar gong non gyi gtor ma bzhugs su gsol/ e khram ras nag gam dar nag gis dkris la nyi zla'i zer/ mar me'i 'od/ bdud rtsi'i zegs pa sogs ni 'jug pa byed/ 'bri gung chos (205)kyi grags pas liṅga la bdud rtsi 'thor na dmer 'gro gsungs/ gshin rje yang bzlog gi khrigs rim du dgug gzhug gi gong du sman mi bran pa gnad zab ces bshad/ gang zag gzhan dag bdud rtsi ni dam ldan sman dang dam nyams la dug tu 'gyur ba'i phyir skyon med par 'chad kyang*/ slob dpon chen pos ling ga la sman raka bdud rtsi ni 'thor ba gal che/ gsungs/ nye logs ci bde bar g.yag rgod kyi rwar thun rdzas ni/ rnye shangs yungs te 'bru gsum/ lcags zangs rdo ste phye ma gsum/ sbang bra ram gsum ste ngan gsum phung pa sogs sa sna dang bye ma/ mdze me rabs chad khra spyang gi khrag sogs khrag sna/ btsan dug sogs dug sna'i rigs te sna gsum rnams kyis bkang ba'i kha dug shog khrol tshags can gyis bkab/ mtha' bskor du mnan snod ni/ rab mon thod gri thod rabs chad thod pa/(306)tha ma spyang dang ra khyi phag pa'i thod pa/ zhes spyir btang dang*/ sri can la mnan thod bye brag pa/ de dag brad (grad bsad )brdar legs par byas pa'i bgram pa g.yas la/ skyes pa pho'i pho sri langs pa nan chings brub/ 'gram sa g.yon la/ bud med kyi mo sri langs pa/ ya rkan la/ mi kha dang bra mchu nan chings brub/ kha la/ byis pa'i chung sri langs pa/ dpral bar/ rgan pa'i rgan sri langs pa/ gdong la/ gzhon pa'i gzhon sri langs pa/ mche ba la/ dar ma'i dar sri langs sa/ spyi bor/ spyi dgra langs pa thams cad/ rna ltag g.yas g.yon du/

phung sri/ god sri langs pa nan chings brub/ ces bris la ring chas cung zad dkri/ bye brag mnan thod dang sa dmigs ni/ dgra 'dre spyi tsam du/ mon pa rabs chad kyi thod par mchod rten gyi zhabs su mnan/ dgra bo spyir spyang ki'am sha khyi'i thod pa/ yang na kho rang gi ba me'i thod pa/ glang (307)ngam g.yag rwa me chus ma phog pa skyes pa la g.yas dang*/ bud med la g.yon lam rgya gram dang la bcos so// 'byung po spyi la phag thod mchod rten zhabs/ de yang zhib tu dbye na dgra 'dre gnyis las/ dang po ni bla ma la bya rgod kyi thod pa'am stag gam byi la khrag ris can gyi thod pa mchod rten zhabs/ dge slong la ngang ser mchod rten/ sngags pa la bya rog lha khang*/ lha sngags dam tshig gcig pa'i mched dang slob ma la/ rus sbal gyi khog pa'am sbal nag gi thod par brag gcan gzan 'dra ba'i 'og bon po dang mu stegs la grum pa dang phag nag gcan gzan gang rung la bcas/ rgyal po la seṅge'i 'am phyi dkar rgya sgo'i them 'og mi dpon glang thod sbrul nag gam rus sbal 'dra ba'i 'og mi skya phag thod dam glang rwa me chus ma phog pa zam rngur/ bud med wa thod rgya (308)lam mam dur khrod/ phyis pa sre mong sgo them 'og mi skya khyer 'dong wa thod shing gcig gi drung rnams su bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ dam sri 'phar spyang khyi thod grong gi dbus/ rnal 'byor pa'i dam sri mi khyi ra phag rabs chad kyi thod pa mchod rten 'og 'gong sri sprel thod lha khang them rgyal po'i phung sri mon bod hor gsum gyi thod pa chos 'khor gyi dbus sam lha khang*/ blon po'i phung sri spre'u ri bong ne tso'i thod pa pho brang gi mdun/ yul mi'i phung sri mdzol rdol dri'u thod pa sbrul gyi srang ngam yul gyi dbus/ dgra sri rta g.yag gi thod pa dgra byung dogs kyi gong gsum mam/ lam rgya gram/ lung gsum mdo/ pho sri g.yag rog gi thod par gangs stongs pa'am ri rtse'i la btsas/

mo sri khyi mo nag mo'i thod pa rgya mtsho'i gting ngam brag gi rtsis/ dar sri wa dmar gyi thod pa dur gyi 'og chung sri ri'u lu gu khyi gu mig ma bye pa shor skyes (309)dang*/ pho bu sre mong thod pa ma yi mal (mang )'og gam lam rgya gram/ rgan sri wa thod chad pa'i zhabs/ dur sri wa thod dur khrod dbus/ dbul sri spyang ki'am ri bong gi thod pa rgya thab kyi 'og phung sri rnga mo'i thod pa grog po phug rgyun du/ lceb sri rbab sri phag thod rgya gram lam/ dme sri skya ga'i thod pa khang pa'i zhabs/ gri sri sha ba'i thod pa la bcas 'og rta sri rta thod ri chen zhabs/ god sri 'phar spyang ra lug spre'u/ 'bri rog gam be'u/ yang na god mgo phyi ma ra ba'i dbus/ g.ya' mo'i god sri 'khar ba rnga mo gsa' yi thod pa 'grog lhas/ ser sri sha ba'i thod pa ser ba 'ong ba'i sgang zur gyi rmang sa/ zhing sri glang ra'am rdza'i sar 'od kha'i dbus rnams su mnan par bya'o// gzhan yang mngon spyod kyi yi ge las/ dgra yul ni mthun pa yin na: dgra bo'i yul gru gang zhig gi thod par mnan: dgra (310)bo'i dmag dpon dred mong gi thod pa dang : dmag gi ngom gi thod par mnan: yul mkhar dang nor rdzas spre'u thod par mnan: khyad par gang rung gi dgra dang sri mnan yin na: dgra bo'i tshe rgyud dang rgan sri rnams dom mgo'i nang du mnan: dgra bo chung rgyud dang mo sri rnams phag mgo'i nang du mnan: gzhon sri dang dbul sri rnams spyang ki'i mgor mnan: chung sri dang the'u rang rnams sre mong mgor/ god sri dang nad sri langs pa bya rog gi mi kha dang kha mchu langs pa rnams wa yi/ nad yams dang zhing kha'i sri rnams bong bu'i/ khyim du 'dre chags dang 'gong po'i sri zhugs na ri bong gi rgyal bsen dang 'byung pos rgyun du za kha zug na kha twa'i/ sun kha dang gshed kha sdang na 'ug pa'i/ sgrub la phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa byung na ra'i/

pha rol gyi byad zor dang dmod pa rgyun du zug na/ skyug ka dang bya rog 'ug pa dur bya rnams kyi mgo (311)bor liṅga bzhag cing mi mgo'i nang du bcug te mnan: zhes dang*/ dgra bo dpung chen che ba yi: dmag dpon sogs la sba ba nas: gangs ri spang ri rdza ri la: rtse mo nag por 'dug pa na: mgo chad 'dun phog ri yin pas: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: dgra bo dpung chan chung ba dang : yul mi la sogs dgra yi rigs: mi nag mtshon cha drud 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: phung sri langs dang nang 'khrug la: gnam lcags mchod rten brtsegs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: gri sri gzhon sri langs pa na: chos 'byung dgu brtsegs bsnol 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: chung sri bud med sri yin na: btsun mo brang rgyan btags 'dra'i ri: mdun gsham 'og tu dgra bo mnan: sgo nor phyugs kyi sri yin na: spre'u dkar bya ra bltas 'dra'i ri: (312)de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: yul dang zhing gi sri yin na: seṅge gnam du mchongs 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: kha mchu mi kha'i sri yin na: bya nag sha la rngams 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: dam pa chos kyi sri yin na: glegs bam po ti gshig 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: chos sgrub bar gcod sri yin na: bla ma khri khar bzhugs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: phyogs zas mtho gnon sri yin na: rgyal po la thod bsdams 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: zhes gsungs gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa lta dgongs ldan phyin rwa tso'i rigs dang*/ ku ba bya sgong sogs rang byung gi snod/ rdza'i ga'u la cha'i sgrom bu lcags zangs zha nye'i par bu/ tsha tsha'i zhabs sogs su rung*/ man ngag snying gzer nag po/ srid pa'i gser khyim/ man ngag rdzogs 'phrang (313) rdo rje gtsug lag sogs khog dbub/ gyim shang mkha' 'gro'i yig chung las/

gtor ma ni dang po mngar la sprad/ de nas sha khrag gis mchod/ gsungs pa bzhin 'gugs ring dkar mngar gyis sbags pa'i gtor zlum mtheb skyu can dang*/ las grub nas sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i dmar gtor bshams nas gtang rag tu khas blangs te 'jog pa sogs mthong rgyun ltar bya/ mi bsad gri 'brong rnga/ sats+tsha nag po/ dur g.yam steng rgya'i ri mo can/ brub khung gi g.yas g.yon du lha dbye'i sgo gnyis 'dzugs/ gzhan yang mnan bsad sogs kyi dus tshod nges pa ni/ khyad par dpyid gsum bdun gsum/ dbyar gsum brgyad gsum/ ston gsum dgu gsum dgun gsum gyi/ yar ngo'i bcu dang mar ngo'i lnga*/ dgu stong rnams la mgon skyabs bral/ gnad 'gag 'di min (314)gzhan du ltos/

las 'brel rtsal gyi gshin rje'i las mtha' dgra kha la rgyas 'debs las/ glang gi zla ba'i nya yi tho rangs mnan na: gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi steng du 'gro: steng gi nyi ma srod la mnan na: sa rim ba dgu'i 'og tu 'gro: me thog tu 'gro ba de la mnan no: zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ ji skad du/ bla phur snying phur srog phur gsum: 'di gsum med par las sbyor ba: bya rgod gzan khed gshog mi phebs: zhes dang*/ 'ja' tshan ma ning gi dmar khrid yig chung las/ bla phur srog phur snying phur gsum gyi gnad ma shes na/ sgrub pa don med du 'gro nyen yod/ ces gsungs pas/ bya rgod kyi dang rur bla phur bca'/ de la gzhung gi bla 'gugs kyi sngags dang*/ bla mi ru brdzu na pho nya srin po'i rbad sngags/ u pa ti tsit+ta nag po u pa ti sa (315)sod/ 1 g.yag sar brdzun stag gzig rbad pa'i sngags/ khaṃ bla tri ta u dan+t+ri sod/ dgra bo dum bu gtsug ta sri sod/ khug ling rtsit+ta nag po sod/ a ti su ti sa ya sod/ kha rag yag sod/ 2 gnyan dang bong bu'i pho nya dom dred gnyis/ oṃ ag so rbad su sod/ 3 ra dang lug la lcags kyi spyang ki'o/ rtsa rag kha tsa rag kha/ kha rag rbad dgra bo sod/ ma gi dgra snying dum bur sod/ pa sha khrag rbad su chod/ 4 ces pa'i mthar/ bla sha re ma ti gh+raṃ sha re ma ti thum thum gug thum ril/ zhes sbrel nas bzlas pa dang*/ seng phur sor brgyad par snying phur du bcas par/ rbad sngags gong ma'i sham bur/ myog myog ye mug tsar ling rbad/ ces bzla/ gri lcags kyi phur pa srog phur du bcas par mnan gzhung gi bsad (316) sngags sham bur/ thibs dar ya thibs srog la rbad/ snying mgo chod/ kha la za mu long rbad/ ces pa rnams rab brgya 'bring gang lcogs/ tha ma nyer gcig bzlas nas phur pa so sor btab ste/ gdab pa'i dus/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ she tri ku ku la yaṃ shri ma ra ya shri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bla gnas dang bstun nas bla srog 'jom skabs gdab pas gnyugs la yid chags/

yid la bla 'khor/ bla srog zung 'brel gyi rgyu sa la pur pa gdab pas srog 'gags te dbugs chad/ bla bsad pas rnam shes kyi rten med par gsungs so// ༈ liṅga lteb pa'i gnad ni/ dgra 'dre gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ liṅga ltag pa bcag ste snying ga'i nṛ la kha sbyar: 'phongs nas yar lteb ste mtshan ma lhag pa la kha sbyar: de nas g.yas lteb dang g.yon lteb lan gsum byas la: zhes dang*/ bla ma (gong ma )dgongs (317)'dus kyi bsru+ung bzlog bsad pa'i gab yig byad ma stobs 'joms las/ lteb tshul gong dang 'dra bar gsungs pa'i rjes rim gyi lte ba la gru gsum du byung ba dang*/ rtse (mthur )thur du phyogs par: yug sa'i dor rtas dril: de ro ras kyis dril ba sogs gsungs/ tsakra'i yig 'bru rnams ye shes lha yi ngo bor gyur pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs: dmod bcol sngags sgra dang bcas pas zlog byed kyi las byed par bsam: zhes dang*/ lnga pa chen pos liṅga'i yi ger byug rdzas la dbyer 'byed mdzad pa'i dgongs pa mthun/ de la shi lteb du 'bod/ ro ltaib du byed na/ kha rkub sprad/ 'dre lteb la snying ga'i sa bon bcag bgegs rigs la 'di nyid rang shas che bar gsungs/ de rjes pho la dpung pa g.yas dang*/ mo la g.yon sngon la (318)gcog mgo nas mar dril ba dang*/ mjug nas yar lteb tsam byed pa'i lugs gnyis snang ba snga ma ltar na phyi ma 'thad par sems/ rus lteb ni dkyil gzhung bcag ste zur gnyis lteb pas kha sbyar zur gsum du yod/ lpags lteb nar mor dril/ mtshon lteb bam ro sgong du grags pa gong du bshad/ gzhung gzhan las/ g.yas kyis g.yon bkab: mgo nas mar dril/ gsungs pa gang ltar byed kyang yugs sa ma skyes pa gzhan dang 'khṛg pa ma spyad cing*/ yun ring ma song ba'i skra shad dang*/ ban bon gyi lag nas byung ba'i tshon skud sngon dmar ram/ sna lngar spro na ser po la/ badz+ra te ri bi ri rbud/

dmar po la kha la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rbad/ sngon por/ dan ti rbad su rbad/ dkar po la/ lo shig kha du 'byung ba trig na nan/ nag po la/ zla sri/ sri sha sod hūm̐/ zhes brgya brgya re btab pa sde brgyad kyi byad thag (319)du bsams la dkris/ mnan chas gzhung bzhin bya'o// ༈ lto phye brtag pa ni/ bsam brgyad kyi 'grel par/ lto phye gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ni// ston zla gsum gyi zla ba la// nyi ma 'gro pa'i rim pa bzhin// go shar kha lho g.yon gyis nyal// dgun zla gsum gyi zla ba la// nub tu kha bltas mgo bo lho// dpyid zla gsum gyi zla ba la// byang du kha bltas nub tu mgo /dbyar zla gsum gyi zla ba la// shar du kha bltas byang du mgo /sa bdag lto phye de ltar gnas// skyes bu chen pos lto phye brko// zhes pa ltar las tshes zhag sum brgya drug cu'i re'u mig la longs spyod pa'i thig ma nor bar gdab cing lto ba'i thad nas brko'o// de la mnan pa'i dngo tshad ni/ gter khyim las/ gru gang yan chad sa ro yin: phan gnod med do: de nas sor dgu ma mo'i gnas yin (320)'gong chog mnan: de nas sor bcu brtan ma'i gnas yin pas dgra bgegs mnan: de nas sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi klu'i gnas yin pas mnan na dgra phung ngo : zhes dang*/ zur gsum thod pa shong ba 'dru: de bas ring na rtsub ste rang la ldog: de bas thung ba 'jam pas dgra mi 'chi'o: zhes dang*/ rdo rje gtsug lag las gong du bshad pa dang mthun pa'i brtan ma'i gnas de la mnan pa thams cad shis par gsungs pas de tsam mdo rgyas 'tshams las grub nas ngag tu/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma ki ki dgra bgegs sarba trig nan rbad nan: bhi na cit+ta rbad nan lam nan nan/ zhes brgya stong bzlas pas phyis mi ldang*/ khrom dang mi mang gi gseb tu 'khyams pa dang cal col 'brel med lab pa ming bsgyur ba sogs kyang byas pas rang la mi ldog gzhan yang lha lnga gshed 'bebs kyi skor gnam skas (321)(322)gter ma sogs la 'dris par yang bya'o// zhes mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis gzhan ngo bsrung phyir rang lo nyi shu pa la'o// nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i lhun po ches// bdud bgegs ldang du med par mnan nas kyang*// sgrib gnyis dri ma med pa'i dpal chen po// yid can lhag ma med pas mngon gyur shog
/ces kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i rdo rje'i gsung la dpe ris sogs zhal 'phang rnams spyi 'gros rgyan te dpal chen 'dus pas bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// ////////////////////////////
